quote: No. I mean, maybe my wife. I'm not I'd have to look at that, but it it the two of us, we live together, still married.
stewart_read: Customer flagged genuine uncertainty about title ownership; rep should have flagged this for follow-up before assuming exclusion later.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged it low-stakes since customer himself wasn't sure, deferring to closer to sort out.
coaching_implication: Rep should have said 'no worries, let's just double check when you get a chance' and revisited before booking single-attendee appointment.

quote: I guess if your wife isn't on the title, then we could just do it with you.
stewart_read: Rep books the appointment for one person based on an assumption rather than confirming title status, risking a structurally vulnerable set if she is in fact a co-owner.
coaching_implication: Should have said 'let's just include her to be safe' — costs nothing, protects the sit.

quote: But this just looking at the options of the different lease the PPAs, I think they're called, like, leases.
stewart_read: Customer discloses a prior Ionic quote/design that 'wasn't the right fit' but rep never asks what specifically didn't work.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may be intentionally leaving this for the specialist to dig into during the proposal call.
coaching_implication: A quick 'what wasn't the right fit last time?' would surface objections before the closer call and let Holland flag them in the handoff.

stewart_read: Bill is captured cleanly with both winter and summer figures.
coaching_implication: Good capture; see anchor_use for whether it was flipped into leverage.

quote: We can definitely help get that cut down. I know that ComEd is they've been raising their rates quite a bit from what I've heard
stewart_read: Rep partially flips the bill by aligning against ComEd's rate hikes, giving the customer an external villain instead of just filing the number.
alternative_hypothesis: Could be read as a generic acknowledgment rather than a deliberate flip since it lacks a direct tie to the customer's specific dollar figure going forward.
coaching_implication: Solid instinct; would land harder tied explicitly back to '$2.70 bill' language later in the call.

quote: And so just so you know, I just sent it back to you.
stewart_read: Customer proactively completes the bill-send task without prompting or follow-up, a strong buy-in signal.
coaching_implication: Rep acknowledged briefly ('Oh, awesome. Thanks.') — could have used the moment to reinforce momentum toward the appointment.
